text: Among the many Orthodox Catechisms there is none more authoritative, none more comprehensive, than Peter Mogila's Confessio Ortkodoxa, which we here reproduce after an old English translation, only altering some archaisms in spell- ing and a few inexact expressions.
text_raw:
Among  the  many  Orthodox  Catechisms  there  is  none  more
authoritative,  none  more  comprehensive,  than  Peter  Mogila's
Confessio  Ortkodoxa,  which  we  here  reproduce  after  an  old
English  translation,  only  altering  some  archaisms  in  spell-
ing and  a  few  inexact  expressions.

text: Peter Mogila, the son of Symeon Ivanovitch, hospodar of Wallachia, was raised in 1632 to the Metropolitan see of KiefP.
text_raw:
Peter  Mogila,  the  son  of  Symeon  Ivanovitch,  hospodar  of
Wallachia,  was  raised  in  1632  to  the  Metropolitan  see  of
KiefP.

text: He was a man distinguished by learning and piety, who made it the aim of his life to combat the doctrinal errors of Eomanism and Calvinism.
text_raw:
He  was  a  man  distinguished  by  learning  and  piety,
who  made  it  the  aim  of  his  life  to  combat  the  doctrinal  errors
of  Eomanism  and  Calvinism.

text: For this purpose he prepared, or rather revised, in a provincial synod (1640), assisted by three Bishops, a Catechism, whose author is said to have been Isaias Trophimovitch Koslovsky, Igumen (abbot) of a Kieff monastery.
text_raw:
For  this  purpose  he  prepared,
or  rather  revised,  in  a  provincial  synod  (1640),  assisted  by
three  Bishops,  a  Catechism,  whose  author  is  said  to  have  been
Isaias  Trophimovitch  Koslovsky,  Igumen  (abbot)  of  a  Kieff
monastery.

text: Subsequently the Synod of Jassy examined it, and in 1643 the four Patriarchs approved and recommended it as a safe and faithful guide for all Orthodox Christians.
text_raw:
Subsequently  the  Synod  of  Jassy  examined  it,
and  in  1643  the  four  Patriarchs  approved  and  recommended
it  as  a  safe  and  faithful  guide  for  all  Orthodox  Christians.

text: Anglican and Protestant divines generally, seeing the agreement of our Catechism with expressions and doctrines of the Council of Trent, have denounced it as tainted with Latinism.
text_raw:
Anglican  and  Protestant  divines  generally,  seeing  the
agreement  of  our  Catechism  with  expressions  and  doctrines
of  the  Council  of  Trent,  have  denounced  it  as  tainted  with
Latinism.

text: But they forgot all the while what a large por- tion of Orthodox teaching the Latin Church had preserved, and how the common fight of the Greek and the Latin Churches against the inroad of Protestantism into the East and West could but welcome the points of contact between the two Churches.
text_raw:
But  they  forgot  all  the  while  what  a  large  por-
tion of  Orthodox  teaching  the  Latin  Church  had  preserved,
and  how  the  common  fight  of  the  Greek  and  the  Latin
Churches  against  the  inroad  of  Protestantism  into  the  East
and  West  could  but  welcome  the  points  of  contact  between
the  two  Churches.

text: But the careful examination and appro- bation of the highest ecclesiastical authorities are a sure guarantee that our faith is here represented pure and un- tainted.
text_raw:
But  the  careful  examination  and  appro-
bation of  the  highest  ecclesiastical  authorities  are  a  sure
guarantee  that  our  faith  is  here  represented  pure  and  un-
tainted.
